label: Bible Study
prompt: And all the _____ of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD'S: it is holy unto the LORD.
verse: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD'S: it is holy unto the LORD.
note: The tithe — a tenth of the harvest, belonging to the LORD before the farmer ever counts it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and _____.
verse: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
note: Joshua and Caleb's plea: if the LORD delights in us, He'll bring us into a land of milk and honey.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And in the _____ watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
verse: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
note: The fourth watch was roughly 3 to 6 a.m. — the disciples had been out all night when Jesus came walking on the sea.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face _____ while he talked with him.
verse: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
note: Moses came down glowing from Sinai and was the last to know — he later wore a veil when he spoke to the people.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The discretion of a man _____ his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
verse: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
note: 'The discretion of a man deferreth his anger' — and it is his glory to pass over an offence. Patience as honour.
